svg.title: NorthRL × Weaver — Async Batching with NorthGate and Persistent E2B Agents
svg.desc: A 24-second conceptual animation. E2B agents send model requests through their local HTTP relay to NorthGate, which connects to Weaver inference. Responses and token metadata return through NorthGate to the sandbox. This model-call path is separate from the training-data path: completed E2B rollouts enter NorthRL groups. With three trajectories per group and two complete groups per batch, B and then A become ready; batch 01 dispatches and trains while C3 continues its long rollout. C2 arrives during training and C3 remains in flight. After training and weight export, Weaver temporarily holds the model request to retract and update weights, then resumes generation. NorthGate continues to connect the same agent to inference. The E2B agent process, workspace, task, and existing token prefix persist throughout; no agent restart is required. Other agents can execute tools while model requests wait. Partial traces are not independent training samples. Full-FT retract behavior requires a supporting backend. Timings are illustrative, not performance measurements.
svg.text: Async batches. Agents that stay alive.

g.text: HOLD THE REQUEST, KEEP THE AGENT

svg.text: Tool work can continue during model sync.

g.text: Next batch filling · C3 still in flight
ALIVE · same process · same workspace · same task
Model requests may wait during weight sync. The agent is neither stopped nor restarted.
